GOP Super PAC Shifts Millions From NC to Kansas Senate Races

A Republican Super PAC has canceled its planned spending in the North Carolina Senate race and is redirecting millions of dollars to defend a seat in Kansas. Sources indicate this shift involves a significant reallocation of funds, with the group scaling back its efforts in North Carolina while increasing investment in Kansas.
